caption: The drawing depicts a profile view of a rooster-shaped weather vane rendered in shades of grey pencil on an off-white background. The rooster features a large, rounded tail, a distinct comb on its head, a pointed beak, and a smooth, solid body with visible wood grain texture suggesting it is crafted from wood. A narrow vertical rod is attached below the body, serving as the support for the weather vane. The entire rooster and rod are positioned centrally within a double-bordered rectangular frame. Near the lower right corner, the signature "Raymond Bunnell" appears. At the bottom center of the drawing, a small ruler or scale is illustrated horizontally for measurement reference. The lines are precise, and the shading accentuates the texture and three-dimensionality of the rooster figure.
title: Cock Weather Vane
